children: First Internet Bancorp completed a private placement of $20.5 million in 8.0% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due 2036, strengthening its capital and liquidity. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes, including potential redemption of higher-rate debt. In connection with the offering, the company entered into a Registration Rights Agreement to conduct an exchange offer for registered notes and executed a Fifth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank, as trustee, governing the new securities. The notes pay a fixed 8.0% until Sep. 15, 2031, then reset quarterly at three-month term SOFR plus 3.735%.
